pages.title: Form of the Self
pages.text: A small crystal figure, faceted and without flaw, that is unmistakably me - not as I am but as Plato would have said I am meant to be. In the Realm of Forms every imperfect copy defers to its ideal, and this is the ideal I can point to when the Realm asks who I claim to be.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Platonic Realm treated me as a poor copy of something and tried to correct me. I cut Cherenkov quartz around a quantum dot that held my own readings, and set it in a Cherenkov lattice. With an ideal to answer to, the Realm stopped trying to fix me.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.
